elaine (Partner Ops): Quick sync — AcmeHW on-prem preview + marketplace packaging. Need to lock NDA language, embargo dates, bench plan, and telemetry gating. Can we align this week?
Mike (Eng): Yep. Do we have partner constraints around publishing numbers?
Raja (AcmeHW): Partner asks: no public performance numbers until joint announcement. Internal sharing OK with watermark. Embargo window = 2 weeks post-announcement for community posts.
Silvia (Bench): Got it. What workload do we run? Chat-gen? embeddings? thermal soak?
elaine (Partner Ops): Primary goal = chat gen (2k context), secondary = embedding throughput. Also validate thermal envelope for rack configs.
Ana (Legal): I'll need the draft NDA clause. Raja, can Acme sign our standard preview addendum or do you require specific language?
Raja (AcmeHW): We prefer adding an "embargo and embargoed-results" clause + limited-share list. We can review your addendum.
Mike (Eng): For bench harness, plan to use our rbench harness v2.2. Small config snippet below we expect to run on partner device:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-xl-2k",
  "sequence_length": 2048,
  "batch": 1,
  "concurrency": 8,
  "quant": "q4_0"
}```
Silvia (Bench): Also need sample prompt set and rubric for quality checks. Can we ask Acme for perf telemetry access (sftp or telemetry-agent)?
Raja (AcmeHW): We'll provide one pre-signed S3 bucket for logs + an ssh key for remote agent. No open outbound telemetry — agent must push to our collector or s3.
Mike (Eng): We can push agent output to your S3. We'll include minimal identifiers. Which telemetry keys can be shared?
Raja (AcmeHW): Share: host-id (hashed), model-version, latency/p95/p99, token-count, thermal-sensor-avg. Do not share raw request texts.
Silvia (Bench): Ack. For acceptance gating propose: p99 latency <= 600ms for 512-token responses, sustained tokens/s >= 1200 on 4-GPU rack, quality BLEU-like score delta <= 2% vs baseline. If failure, we log and run mitigation (batch tuning / kv-cache tweaks).
elaine (Partner Ops): Sounds reasonable. Timeline: ship unit week of 04/11, run bench 04/18-04/22, sync 04/25 to review results, joint announcement target 05/09. Is that doable?
Raja (AcmeHW): Ship: can do 04/12. Remote agent access provided 04/15. Embargo window ok for 05/09 announcement.
Ana (Legal): I'll post NDA addendum draft by EOD today to the shared drive. Please review and comment.
Mike (Eng): One more: runtime patch to limit fan curves and thermal throttling landed in staging. We'll push to preview build before 04/15. deploy-bot: deployed/preview/runtime/patch-thermal v0.3 -> staging :rocket:
deploy-bot: calendar_event_created: "AcmeHW preview bench window" 2024-04-18 09:00-17:00 (invite sent)
Silvia (Bench): Bench commands we plan to run (example):```bash
rbench --model redwood-chat-xl-2k --seq 2048 --qps 30 --duration 3600 --save telemetry.json
scp telemetry.json s3://acme-preview-results/XXXX
```
Raja (AcmeHW): Confirmed. We'll whitelist IPs for scp access.
elaine (Partner Ops): Can Marketing block dates for joint announcement collateral review on 05/02? Need 1 full week for creative + legal review.
Ana (Legal): Put 05/02 on calendar for pre-announce review. I'll review embargo text then.
Mike (Eng): QA note: include a short regression suite (5 prompts) that checks hallucination rate and token-efficiency. Silvia, I'll drop sample prompts in the drive.
Silvia (Bench): 👍 will add to harness.
Raja (AcmeHW): One ask: please watermark internal slides and results with "Draft — AcmeHW + Redwood (Internal)" for internal sharing.
elaine (Partner Ops): Noted. We'll enforce watermark on all artifacts.
Ana (Legal): Quick flag — if marketing wants to include microbench numbers in the announcement, legal needs final sign-off from both sides 72 hours before public.
Mike (Eng): Understood. We'll aim to have final numbers ready by 05/06.
elaine (Partner Ops): Ok — action items: Ana: NDA addendum draft today. Raja: confirm S3 path + IP whitelist by 04/15. Mike & Silvia: bench harness + prompts by 04/15. Marketing: block 05/02 review. We'll reconvene 04/15 for access verification. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Raja (AcmeHW): Thanks, team. Looking forward to it.
